name: Hitotsu Yane no Shita de...
original_name: ひとつ屋根の下で・・・
source:
"Under One Roof..." took me all of last night to finish yesterday.
A naive girl living an impure life day after day... Her first kiss, losing her virginity...
everything is attacking her from all sides. And all while you don't have a clue... 
Will you be able to stand watching someone whom you care for bear the pain of these events?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035062.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《同一屋檐下……》花了我昨晚一晚上才完成。
一个天真的女孩，日复一日过着不纯洁的生活……她的初吻，失去了童贞……
一切都在从四面八方攻击她。而在你毫无头绪的时候… 
你能忍受看着你所关心的人承受这些事件的痛苦吗？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035062.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
